answer: LINE(2nd) is the method evaluated on word analogy using Wikipedia word networks. Node2vec is the method that reuses samples across source nodes to improve sampling efficiency, through precomputed alias tables for its biased second-order transitions. This second attribution is my best inference and is not clearly confirmed.
confidence_reasoning: The LINE word-analogy attribution is fairly plausible from memory of its experiments, but the claim about node2vec's sample reuse across source nodes is an uncertain interpretation of the efficiency mechanism.
